title: Compute Harris texture coefficients and standard deviation
action: Read the experimental XRD intensities I(1010) and I(110) for each film from the provided data table (embedded in the instruction). Use the Harris equations: TC_{(hkl)} = (I_{(hkl)} / I⁰_{(hkl)}) / ((1/N) Σ (I/I⁰)) and σ = sqrt( Σ (TC_{(hkl)} - 1)² / N ), with N=2, I⁰_{(1010)}=25, I⁰_{(110)}=25. Compute TC(110) and σ for each film. Write results to /app/outputs/texture_results.csv.
description: Harris texture analysis results: TC(110) and standard deviation σ for each of the four Bi2Te3 films. Film names must match exactly: constant_potential_+0.02V, pulsed_5s_5s, pulsed_0.1s_0.1s, pulsed_0.01s_0.01s.
output_schema: CSV with columns: film (string), TC_110 (float), sigma (float). Example row: constant_potential_+0.02V, 1.9575, 0.9627
